review_description: The only company who contacted me from my enquiry on your website and after talking to people at my work Solarcell was recommended and seeing the quotes people got from various companies and the difference in panels it was a no brainer. James from Solarcell is not a multi national company in it to rip people off, he is down to earth and does not spin you; no fancy talk.
Solar companies advertising through TV or the papers are quoting high $$ on cheaper system.If you don't know or don't do your homework you will be ripped off.
Solarcell were a fantastic company to work with they are a small one man business but I have alrady recommended him to some friends. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them again.
